acceptanceCriteria: An owner-accepted rule either forbids path:line citations into BUILD-LOG (cite the entry heading instead) or makes the log append-only at the end, and the mixed ordering is resolved.
line-citations-check or a sibling check enforces the rule.
Existing BUILD-LOG line citations are converted.
body: Filed 2026-09-24. Decisions such as 0375 cite `docs/BUILD-LOG.md:<line>@<anchor>`. BUILD-LOG is newest-first, so every new top entry shifts those lines and line-citations-check fails until the citation is repinned. On 2026-09-24 PRs #153, #158, #159 and the V1-0236 branch each had to repin 0375 lines 13 and 40, and parallel repins produced merge conflicts in the decision file. Some recent entries are appended at the end instead, so the log's ordering is also mixed.
title: docs: BUILD-LOG path:line citations shift whenever an entry is added at the top, forcing repins in unrelated PRs
